verdict: Good app, but not top-tier yet
verdict_explanation: Loop 11 resolves F-007 (useTierFilter unit test) and F-008 (filterAllTiers unit test). 22 suites, 146 tests, all green. test_strategy 7.0→7.5 (two Interface-level test gaps closed); credibility 7.5→8.0 (no remaining honesty leaks from loop 5-11 trajectory). Remaining open finding: F-004 (TierBoardPage 507 LOC).

architecture_quality.proof: apps/web/src/pages/TierBoardPage.tsx:1-507 (507 LOC, 20 hook calls, shallow orchestration wrapper); apps/web/src/pages/ImportExportPage.tsx:1-438 (438 LOC); apps/web/src/pages/HeadToHeadPage.tsx:1-378 (378 LOC). 9-anchor not met: page shells lack Interface Depth. Package DAG enforced by workspace; no structural source changes loop 11.

state_management.proof: packages/state/src/tierSlice.ts:1-343 — one writer per concern across 6 slices. memoized selectors in selectors.ts. Process-lifetime ownership not explicit (store is implicit global). 9-anchor sub-threshold.

domain_modeling.proof: packages/core/src/models.ts:6 — Item interface is a data bag (name?, imageUrl?, description? all optional). Items = Record<string, Item[]> anemic. No smart constructors, no validated values. 9-anchor requires types prove most invariants by construction — not met.

data_flow.proof: Package-level DAG enforced by workspace package.json (core←state←apps). No circular deps. useTierFilter.ts and useTierDisplay.ts create cleaner hook interfaces. Within-app no module-level DAG enforcement. 9-anchor partial.

framework_idioms.proof: React custom hooks idiomatic (6 focused hooks in apps/web/src/hooks/). RTK patterns correct. useId() for stable IDs. apps/web/src/pages/ImportExportPage.tsx at 438 LOC still mixes orchestration and display without hook delegation. 9-anchor nearly met but no documented carve-outs.

concurrency.proof: JavaScript single-threaded. No floating promises found. useEffect cleanup present in CelebrationEffect.tsx. No AbortController pattern for async fetches. persistenceMiddleware per-instance timer (loop 8). 9-anchor partial.

simplicity.proof: apps/web/src/pages/TierBoardPage.tsx:1-507 (507 LOC, 20 hook calls); ImportExportPage.tsx:1-438; AppShell.tsx:1-385; HeadToHeadPage.tsx:1-378; TemplatesPage.tsx:1-361. All large orchestration shells. No simplification changes this loop (test files only).

test_strategy.proof: packages/core/test/filtering.test.ts (loop 11) — 25 tests at filterAllTiers Interface: passthrough (line 128), multi-tier structure (lines 133-147), empty tiers (lines 149-152), hasMedia cross-tier (lines 153-172). apps/web/src/hooks/useTierFilter.test.ts (loop 11) — 7 tests via renderHook+Provider: filter derivation (lines 67-82), searchText (lines 84-95), alphabetical sort (lines 97-106), custom order (lines 108-115), all 3 dispatch callbacks (lines 121-162). Suite: 22 suites, 146 tests, all green. Authority Map cross-check: filterAllTiers Interface directly tested; useTierFilter Interface directly tested. F-007 and F-008 resolved. Remaining ceiling: TierBoardPage page-level surface has no direct test — keeps 9-anchor unmet.

credibility.proof: Loop 11 adds 32 tests at the Interfaces of two previously-untested Modules (filterAllTiers: filtering.test.ts:96-176; useTierFilter: useTierFilter.test.ts:67-162). Both pass Replace-don't-layer: no prior tests existed, so no deletion needed. Implementation reviewer approved. No fake-clean moves in loops 5-11. Each resolved finding survived source inspection.

Monorepo DAG enforced by workspace package.json: core←state←apps; no circular dependencies
persistenceMiddleware — fully injectable storage (F-005 resolved loop 8); per-instance timer (F-006 resolved loop 8)
undoRedoThunks — direct test suite covering cross-slice behavior (F-003 resolved loop 7)

useTierFilter.ts — 91 LOC; Interface now directly tested (useTierFilter.test.ts; 7 tests, loop 11)

findings.title: TierBoardPage.tsx at 507 LOC — god-component partially resolved, carried forward
findings.why_it_matters: At 507 LOC with 20 hook calls, the page remains a shallow orchestration wrapper. Shallow-module test still partially applies. No loop-11 changes target this finding.
findings.what_is_wrong: apps/web/src/pages/TierBoardPage.tsx bundles 7 useState modal/UI state (lines 80-86), 8 useCallback handler declarations (lines 133-237), 2 useEffect calls, and JSX render tree. Item interaction handlers may pass deletion test as useItemInteraction hook if they share only dispatch + captureSnapshot without modal state dependency.
findings.leverage_impact: Modal coordination and item handling require reading 507-LOC page.
findings.locality_impact: Bug in file drop handling requires navigating 507 LOC of orchestration.
findings.metric_signal: 507 LOC vs 95 LOC ThemesPage.tsx; 438 LOC ImportExportPage.tsx also large
findings.why_weakens_submission: Page shell still concentrates concerns; test surface at individual behavior level impractical.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Evaluate useItemInteraction hook (handleFileDrop + handleItemMediaDrop + handleItemClick + handleItemDoubleClick): if 4 handlers share only dispatch + captureSnapshot with no modal state dependency, extract to hooks/useItemInteraction.ts. Otherwise accept 507 LOC as natural page orchestration floor.

simplification_check.structurally_necessary: F-008: filterAllTiers Interface had zero tests vs sortItems 8 tests; Interface-as-test-surface test required parity. F-007: useTierFilter is the highest-risk extracted hook; Interface-as-test-surface test proved filter+sort+dispatch correctness.
simplification_check.helpful_simplification: apps/web/jest.config.ts + root test:hooks script adds sustainable path for testing web-layer hooks without adding npm dependencies.
simplification_check.should_not_be_done: Adding a mock Redux store factory abstraction — one-off makeStore per test file is the idiomatic pattern (established in undoRedoThunks.test.ts).
simplification_check.tests_after_fix: For F-008: packages/core/test/filtering.test.ts at filtering Interface (no old tests to delete). For F-007: apps/web/src/hooks/useTierFilter.test.ts at hook Interface (no old tests to delete).

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: New hook file exists with no corresponding .test.ts; behavior was untested inline before and remains untested after extraction
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: For any hook that calls dispatch or reads from the store, add one renderHook test: create store with known state; trigger the callback; assert state changed
builder_notes.stack_example: useTierFilter.test.ts:67-82: renderHook(() => useTierFilter(), { wrapper: wrapper(store) }); assert processedTiers counts reflect the loaded tiers

builder_notes.pattern: Coverage asymmetry between parallel pure functions
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: One function (sortItems) has 8 tests; a parallel function (filterAllTiers) called from the same consumer has 0
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: When adding tests for any function in packages/core/, check its sibling functions in the same file and add proportional tests
builder_notes.stack_example: filtering.ts and sorting.ts both called from useTierFilter; loop 11 closed the asymmetry with 25 new tests in filtering.test.ts

builder_notes.how_to_recognize: Page component with 8+ useCallback hooks; some share only Redux dispatch + domain state; others call local setShow* modal state setters
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Group handlers by dependencies: handlers touching only dispatch + domain state extract cleanly; handlers calling local setShow* must stay in the component
builder_notes.stack_example: handleFileDrop and handleItemMediaDrop in TierBoardPage likely share only dispatch + captureSnapshot; handleMoveItemWithCelebration calls setShowCelebration and cannot be extracted without modal state coupling

narrative: Good app, place but not win. Loop 11 closes the test-strategy gaps (F-007, F-008) that held test_strategy at 7.0 for loops 9-10. 32 new tests at real Interfaces — no shallow mocks, no implementation mirroring. Suite at 146 tests, 22 suites; all green. credibility moves to 8.0: no remaining honesty leaks from the loop 5-11 trajectory. Remaining backlog: F-004 (TierBoardPage 507 LOC; useItemInteraction evaluation). architecture_quality at 6.5 by page shell Depth gap — the 9-anchor requires Module Depth, not just LOC reduction.
